basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 15-year-old high school student from Oregon who loves exploring the internet for interesting topics and communities. I'm new to Reddit, and I'm still getting the hang of it! I have a keen interest in folklore and urban legends, which is why I frequent the 'wendigoon' subreddit. I also enjoy reading and contributing to discussions on 'TwoXChromosomes' as I'm navigating my teenage years. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school. I'm single and focusing on my studies and hobbies for now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a high school student, so most of my knowledge comes from school and my interest in online communities about folklore and women's health topics. I love watching educational YouTube channels and reading about different cultures and stories.
